PLAN-ONLY GUARD CONTRACT (ASM-320, docs/cd-pipeline.md §1):
• Academic DevOps challenge: deployment stops at speculative plan; no live cloud apply or destroy
• Guard job validates commit headers and PR context against plan-only safety regex
• Unattended automatic execution limited to plan-dev and plan-qa; production requires four-eyes human review

div.div:
STACK DEPENDENCY ORDER (PC-IAC-022, docs/cd-pipeline.md):
1. state-backend: S3 remote state bucket, native S3 lockfile, KMS 'state' CMK (Box D02)
2. network: VPC, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway attachments, CC association (Box D04/D05)
3. security: OIDC pipeline IAM roles, Cognito User Pools (staff/field), KMS CMKs, WAF (Box D06)
4. workload: DynamoDB tables, IoT topic rules, EventBridge pipes, SQS queues, Lambdas (D10)

• Blackout: 05:00 to 18:00 Colombia time on harvest-week dates (ASM-007, ASM-178); window check covers full execution
• Advance notice to Federation: default 2 business days lead time before standard change (ASM-173, Q-15)
• Incident change: requires incident_reference (INC-YYYYMMDD-NN, ASM-183) to override harvest blackout

TWO-STEP APPROVAL GATE ON GITHUB FREE (PD-020, docs/cd-pipeline.md §1):
• GitHub Free private repo lacks required environment reviewers; two-step workflow approval binds two named humans
• Approver must be listed in repository variable PDN_APPROVERS (SR1/SR2) and differ from Requester (ASM-172)
• Verifies byte-identical plan digest (SHA-256 of SHA256SUMS) and stores approval-record-pdn for 90 days
